title: PandaAI: A Practical Agent CQ2 for Neuro-symbolic Data Analysis And Integrated Decision-Making in Quantitative Finance

claim.summary: PandaAI combines a regime-conditioned finance LLM with constrained alpha-factor search, portfolio execution and feedback-based rule/model adaptation.

modules.name: Regime soft-token alignment and finance-reasoning adaptation
modules.scope_reason: A latent market-state adapter supplies trainable soft tokens; CQ2 receives regime-conditioned SFT, reasoning SFT and preference training.
evidence_locators: PDF p.17; passage beginning "Regime-Conditioned Instruction Tuning"

modules.name: Financially constrained alpha-factor tree search
modules.scope_reason: Search candidates are formulaic alpha factors and are checked with forbidden operators, backtest performance and portfolio-risk penalties.
evidence_locators: PDF p.6; passage beginning "We conceptualize Alpha Mining"

modules.name: Regime-conditioned portfolio and execution control
modules.scope_reason: Risk aversion, portfolio constraints and execution schedules depend on the market regime and financial objectives.

modules.name: Trading-feedback symbolic constraint induction
modules.scope_reason: Contrasts failed and successful trading examples within a regime to revise financial operator constraints.
evidence_locators: PDF p.7; passage beginning "Fast Loop (Symbolic Rule Induction)"
